verdict.rationale: Sumsub's evidence shows an MCP server that lets external AI agents call Sumsub's API (docs-4, probe-3) and AI-powered anomaly detection for transaction monitoring (docs-24), but neither is a built-in assistant embedded in the Sumsub product that a user converses with or delegates tasks to. No evidence of an in-product AI copilot/assistant UI for compliance analysts or applicants.
